plugin.name: SlopeTrain
plugin.author: Kanaye
plugin.purpose: A plugin to help you lead a slope train
plugin.description: +-------------------------[SlopeTrain Plugin]-------------------------+ | | | Use this plugin to manage the slope train in Icefall! | | Direct your group and provide notifications when moving. | | (edit line 167 to buy other pass!) | +---------------------------------------------------------------------+

muclient.script:
require("wait") require("async") json = require("json") require "gmcphelper"
plugin_url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/st3rv1s/SlopeTrain/refs/heads/main/SlopeTrain.xml" SetVariable("DownloadURL", plugin_url) plugin_protocol = "HTTPS" plugin_prefix = "[SlopeTrain]"
local group_leader = "" local slope_successful = false
function cnote(string) AnsiNote(stylesToANSI(ColoursToStyles(string))) end
-- Function to check if we are the leader function is_leader() group_leader = gmcp("group.leader") or "" local playerName = gmcp("char.base.name") or "" return playerName == group_leader end
-- Send GT message on move with dynamic color for CHOO CHOO function send_gt_message(direction) if is_leader() then local choo_color = "@W" -- Default color (white)
-- Set CHOO CHOO color based on direction if direction == "south" then choo_color = "@R" -- Red for South elseif direction == "west" then choo_color = "@M" -- Magenta for West elseif direction == "east" then choo_color = "@Y" -- Yellow for East end
-- Send the message with the dynamic CHOO CHOO color local msg = string.format("The SlopeTrain is moving @C%s@W. %sCHOO CHOO!!!@W", direction:upper(), choo_color) SendNoEcho("gt " .. msg) end end
-- Go south alias function function GoSouth() if is_in_icefall() then Execute("mapper goto 38813") SendNoEcho("south") if is_leader() then send_gt_message("south") end end end
-- Go east alias function function GoEast() if is_in_icefall() then Execute("mapper goto 38813") SendNoEcho("east") if is_leader() then send_gt_message("east") end end end
-- Go west alias function function GoWest() if is_in_icefall() then Execute("mapper goto 38813") SendNoEcho("west") if is_leader() then send_gt_message("west") end end end
-- Check if we are in Icefall zone function is_in_icefall() local current_zone = gmcp("room.info.zone") return current_zone == "icefall" end
-- Function for expired pass action function ExpiredPassAction() -- Move to the specified location Execute("mapper goto 38714") -- Send the command to buy a new pass SendNoEcho("buy 250usespass") -- Put the pass on the keyring SendNoEcho("keyring put pass") end

trigger.name: ExpiredPass
trigger.match: ^A gruff ski patrol destroys your expired pass\!|You must have a ski pass in order to enter the powerup slopes\.$
